newsitem.title: USA: Morton hailed by stock analysts -newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Morton hailed by stock analysts -newspaper.

text.p: Morton International Inc is a cash-rich cost cutter and therefore a good investment, analysts told the New York Times in its Sunday Money & Business section.
Steve Markusen, portfolio manager for Piper Growth Fund, said the diversified Chicago-based salt company has "a history of paying attention to shareholder value."

Mark Gulley, a Morgan Stanley analyst, said Morton's plans to cut costs, buy chemical companies and repurchase shares could increase earnings by 14 percent a year for the next three years, the Times reported.
Morton shares were down 1/4 to 32-1/4 on Friday. Their year high was 33-1/4, while the low was 28.
